text:
anya: deploy done — release/1.42.0 -> prod at 2026-10-02T13:40:00Z (canary 5% -> 100%). Please run quick post-deploy checks below and ping if you see anything. I'll be monitoring for 30m.

deploy-bot: [CI/CD] rollout completed for service=inference-api tag=sha256:abc123 (duration 3m).

rahul: starting smoke checks now — hitting /health, /v1/generate (sample prompt), and embedding endpoint.

rahul: curl -i https://prod.redwood.ai/health
rahul: curl -i -X POST https://prod.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hello"}'  # expect 200

steph: preliminary metrics: p50 118ms, p95 340ms, token cost normal. No errors in tracing so far.

leo: watching 5xx rate — currently 0.02% over last 5m. GPU util steady ~62%.

sre-oncall: I'll keep eyes on SLO dashboard and CG alerts for 30m. Rollback plan in place: if 5xx > 0.5% or latency p95 > 600ms sustained 2m, we'll roll back.

anya: rollback steps:
anya: 1) kubectl -n prod set image deploy/inference-api inference-api=redwood/inference:prev-tag
anya: 2) kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-api -w
anya: 3) notify #eng-sre and /call page

rahul: smoke payloads all passed locally, sample outputs sane. Uploading a few logs to the thread.

rahul: logs: "warn: kv-cache miss rate 3%, ok"  — no model errors.

steph: added watchlist in console: Dashboard -> inference-api -> last 30m. Alert thresholds copied.

leo: minor issue: one canary pod OOM-killed but restarted, back to healthy. Observability shows <1 pod restart.

anya: ok good — thanks team. If nobody objects I'll close this thread after 30m and mark deploy stable. :thumbsup:
